checks.remediation: Thundermail has no POP service, so this account cannot work as configured. Add the mailbox again as IMAP, using the + Add Account button at the top of the left sidebar in Account Settings. Autoconfiguration should set mail.thundermail.com:993 with Connection security SSL/TLS and Authentication method OAuth2 for incoming mail, and mail.thundermail.com:587 with STARTTLS for outgoing.
checks.provenance: No POP host or port exists in production config, and the Thundermail UI has no POP tab.

checks.message: The password is sent unencrypted over an unencrypted connection.
checks.remediation: Set Connection security to SSL/TLS or STARTTLS, using the port the provider expects for that setting.

checks.message: Server, port and connection security are correct.
checks.provenance: The _submission._tcp SRV record (RFC 6186) -- what Thunderbird autoconfig produces, since Thundermail has no ISPDB entry.

checks.message: An app password works, but OAuth2 is the default and is recommended. Not a reason to change a working account.
checks.remediation: In Thunderbird app menu ☰ → Account Settings → click the account's own row in the left sidebar, not one of the entries beneath it → Outgoing Server, second-to-last row at the bottom right → Edit outgoing server… (opens the SMTP Server dialog), set Authentication method to OAuth2.
